translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Nalam nikil fikal, atin nalam aket fukanin uyo Yu kayak adikum kail bá takeikuyamako, kalbi. Kale be atin nam Got gánlawin ko.
Naka im sung be kale bakodon, ika atin Got yán abodum, kalbiw. Kata tatun leiw Got yán aboyámin bo im kal banim.

Kale ika Got ami wanang kinim imadew maek alam kin dim kidel kei imkanba leiw uyo im kal banim. Kayo ilim leiw kukum uta kanamom naduwo Got kin dim ken keidokabuwo, kalanusiw. Kayo ika Got ami wanang kinim imadew maek alam kin dim ken keimin uyo au, kale yakik fakudongin dakosiw ko.
Kale Kadais ta bom sawa abem aboyámin adik wakadá banimu kudáse. Kayo kan ata aket kudawa kaí, aka ken Got kin dim ken keidokaba ka.
Mosus sawa abem abo bom yak Got kin dim ken keimino, kale godusa. Be aka bako, “kinim kan ata sawa abem be abodokaba, aka ken bokaba.” Kalesa.

Kata Got godin weng bako nadu, “wanang kinim ilim afan kalin uta ta bom Got kin dim ken keidokabiwo,” kalesu uyo bulami sung uta bako, “Kaba kalami uyo bako, ‘kan ata tam abid tikin unokaba.’ kalin bá.” Kalesu. Kale bemi mit ayo ki, kan ata tam abid tikin uyo unom Yesus dabudulokaba ade dew madák bakan tadokaba? Ade God ami godin weng uyo bako,
“kaba kalami uyo bako, ‘kan ata dák kuin bid uyo unokaba.’ kalin bá?” Kale bemi mit ayo ki, be kan ata dák Yesus fikalesa uyo tá dafo dew matam dádokaba? Kalin taw ko.
Kale Got godin weng ade bela bako, “Got kukumin ayo kalami mewso be. Kale bo kalam bon tem so aket tem so kal bu ka.” Kalesu. Kale be afan kalin umi bakamaluw uta ka.
Kale kaba kalam bon tem tuw bako nadaw, “Yesus be Kamok.” Ade alo kaba kalam aket tem uyo bako nadaw, afan Yesus be fikala, Got tá dafose be, kalaw kaí, kaba kail bá takeikukamokaba.
Kala kaleyo nuka nulum aket tem afan kaluw ade nuka Got kin dim ken keiyámaluw. Ade nuka nulum bon tem tuw bako, Yesus be nulum Kamok kaluw ade aka kail bá takeikuyamse kala.
Kale Got godin weng uyo bako, “kan ata aket kudawokaba, aka fatom so keidoma banim.” Kalesu.

Got godin weng uyo bako, “sák wanang kinim kalesu be wataw ata bá yak Yu kayak tadiw, Mifiw tadiw be kukum so bá. Kamok makuw ata kuw adikum imi Kamok ade yak wanang kinim kan ata aket kudawiw iyo Got im kinim dákamin seng kukayamába.” Kalesu.
Got godin weng uyo bako nadu, “wanang kinim kan ata Kamok dakonamako, kale dákadálokaba, aka kail bá takeikudawokaba ko.” Kalesu.

Kata wanang kinim iyo Kamok ken dakoyamako, kalokabiw kaí, ika aket kudaw afan kaliwo beta ko. Ade ika Kamok afan kaliw kaí, alam sung asik kidi nadiwo ade imi Kamok sung kidilokabiw kaí, kinim madik ita ami sung uyo bakoyamiwo.
Ade kinim madik mak yak Kamok ami sung bakoyamokaba kaí, ika Got alata imadála yak nadiwo kuw. Kale be Got godin weng uyo bako, “kinim sung kidel dew tadba, be takak so kinim ko.” Kalesa.
Kata Yu kayak ika adikum sung kidel uyo au, kalesiw bá. Kale Aiseya ayo bako, “Kamok kaba, kan ata num weng uyo afan kalesene?” Kalesa.
Kayo afan kalin be weng kidel kidimin, kal tadebu ade kinim wanang sung kidel kidibiw iyo ki kinim madik ita tad Kadais ami sung uyo bakaya bidiwo kal kidibiw.
Kata naka dákadáli, wanang kinim iyo sung kidel so kidibiwe? Au, be Got godin weng bakosa taw kidisidiw.

content.text: “Kale im weng uyo yak adikum bakan kuw tabodu uyo adik wakadása. Kale weng bo sák bakan bom yak aba maek aba ausu.”

content: Kalesu.
Ade alo sawil dákadáli, “Isadael kayak iyo kidi kal keisidiwe? Au, ika kidi kal keisidiw.” Kali. Kale kamakikiw Mosus asik bako,

content.text: “naka kotadang wanang kinim tuw kanoyami, kiba kilim aket tem titiyamokabiw. Ade naka anang bakan wanang kinim im kal banim imi tuw kanoyami, kiba keng keiyamokaba.”

content: Kalesa.
Kale Aiseya ayo fingánin banim Got ami weng uyo bako,

content.text: “kan ita dakonamako, kale gán dánamongin banim, ika natamokabiw. Ade kan ita nam fenongin banim, ika naka kanoyami natamokabiw.”

content: Kalesa.
Kata Got ayo Isadael kayak sung bako,

content.text: “naka am dánámin adikum uyo sun kuw wanang kinim nam weng kidinamongin banim so yonin so iyo au, yakono, kale faskobi.”

content: Kalesa.
